verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an official MCP server in a dedicated help article, 'Connecting to the Thoropass MCP server.' It lets an AI assistant work inside the workspace within configurable limits. Documented tools cover listing and viewing audits and evidence requests, and adding comments, attachments and status updates, and the docs include example prompts. A probe confirms the documentation exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidenced setup details such as auth method, endpoint and supported clients.
